study_identification_part.si_4_title: Cell type-specific manifestations of cortical thickness heterogeneity in schizophrenia

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: HCP-YA (HCP-1200) and HCP-EP (HCP-Psychosis) were combined for the discovery cohort. ASRB was used as the validation cohort.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: This study comprised a total of 1849 participants drawn from three independent datasets: (1) the Human Connectome Project-Young Adult Sample [15]; (2) the Human Connectome Project for Early Psychosis (HCPpsychosis) [16]; and (3) the Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank (ASRB) [17].

answer.HCP-EP: normative training and patient for clinical research (discovery cohort)

answer.ASRB: normative training and patient for clinical research (validation cohort)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Healthy controls from HCP-YA and HCP-EP were used for discovery cohort normative modeling. Patients from HCP-EP were used for the discovery clinical analysis. ASRB healthy controls and patients were used for the validation cohort.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: The HCP-Young Adult Sample and HCP-psychosis datasets ... combined to form a single discovery cohort ... The ASRB dataset was used to evaluate replicability and validity

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Normative ranges were established on 1127 controls for the HCP discovery cohort and 185 controls for the ASRB validation cohort.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: normative ranges of variation in each brain region were established based on healthy individuals ( n = 1127 for HCP [discovery] and n = 185 for ASRB [validation])
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: DiBiase2022.pdf.md: RESULTS / Heterogeneity in individual CTh deviation profiles

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: HCP Discovery controls (n=1127) mean age 28.50 (SD 3.83). ASRB Validation controls (n=185) mean age 41.05 (SD 14.02).
